# AiContextMenu

```ts
import { AiContextMenu } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The + button of the AI query input and the menu it opens: context types a person can attach to a prompt (Ticket, Power, Application, …), a divider, then File, which opens the system file picker. AiQueryInput renders it for you when you pass contextOptions or onFilesSelected; use it on its own only when building a custom prompt surface. For a general-purpose action menu use the Menu pieces directly.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `AiContextOption[]` | `AI_CONTEXT_OPTIONS` | Context types listed above the divider. |
| `selected` | `string[]` | — | Values already attached — shown with the selected treatment + check. |
| `onToggle` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Called with an option's value when it is chosen (toggle on / off). |
| `onFilesSelected` | `(files: File[]) => void` | — | Called with the files picked from File. When omitted, the divider and File item are not shown. |
| `accept` | `string` | — | accept for the file picker, e.g. ".pdf,.txt,image/*". |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `true` | Allow picking several files at once. |
| `fileLabel` | `string` | `'File'` | Label of the file item. |
| `triggerLabel` | `string` | `'Add context or files'` | Accessible name of the + trigger. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the + trigger. |
| `width` | `number \| string` | `320` | Menu width (px or CSS). |


## Usage

```tsx
<AiContextMenu onToggle={toggle} onFilesSelected={upload} />
<AiContextMenu selected={['power']} onToggle={toggle} />
<AiContextMenu options={myOptions} onToggle={toggle} />
<AiContextMenu onFilesSelected={upload} accept=".pdf,image/*" multiple={false} />
<AiContextMenu onFilesSelected={upload} options={[]} />
<AiContextMenu disabled />
```

## Accessibility

- Radix provides role="menu" / menuitem, arrow-key roving focus, typeahead, and Esc to close with focus returned to +.
- The + is icon-only, so it is named by triggerLabel (default "Add context or files"). Rename it if your menu only adds files or only adds context.
- Selection isn't shown by color alone: a selected row also gets a trailing check and medium weight.
- File activates a hidden <input type="file">, so the system picker handles keyboard and screen-reader use.
- Focus is restyled on each row and on the trigger, never removed.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Let AiQueryInput render it via contextOptions / onFilesSelected | Render a second + next to the query input's own |
| Keep context labels short nouns ("Ticket", "Power") — they become chips | Use long sentences; the chip truncates them |
| Pass accept when the assistant only reads some file types | Accept every type and fail after upload |
| Reflect selected from your state so the check matches the chips | Leave selected static while chips change |
